reviewNotes: KupaPay Pro removes ads, adds automatic trip currency conversion, and PDF export for groups. Trip Pass is a one-time purchase that unlocks Pro for every member of one group for 30 days (no auto-renewal). Monthly and yearly plans may include a 7-day free trial in Israel. Use Sandbox Apple ID to test purchases on the in-app paywall.
